notes.title: "Star Shift: Rebellion" Has Launched!
notes.notes:
We're thrilled to announce that the next chapter in the Star Shift Saga, "[b]Star Shift: Rebellion[/b]," has been launched! Now's your chance to pick up a copy of your own! Launch the Rebellion from your PC!

[previewyoutube=LGeaASEtfK8;full][/previewyoutube]

Infernis Prime: a mining colony on the edge of the Outer Rim, languishes under a brutal occupation. Within the shadows of this forsaken world, a spark of hope flickers. With the help of a hacked android and the discovery of a dark secret, the seeds of the future take root. "Star Shift: Rebellion" unfolds with the gripping tale of the Outer Rim Coalition's formation and their quest for liberation.

[b]The Saga Begins:[/b] Today, you are invited to step into a universe where the fabric of reality is not what it seems, and the line between right and wrong blurs with each revelation. Will you rise as the beacon of hope in a galaxy consumed by darkness? Or will you forge a path of power, regardless of the cost? The legacy of "Star Shift: Rebellion" is not written in the stars but by the hands of those brave enough to take the helm.

[b]Chart Your Course: [/b]Beyond the rebellion, beyond the fight for freedom, lies the truth to alter the course of history. Engage in strategic combat that challenges both your intellect and your resolve. Navigate alliances, uncover secrets, and make decisions that will define the legacy of the Outer Rim Coalition.

The universe of "Star Shift: Rebellion" awaits. Are you ready to uncover the truth, join the fight, and lead the rebellion? Chart Your Course: [b]Join the Rebellion Today![/b].

notes.title: Star Shift Has Been Updated to 0.64
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=7WFiIsG5MlY;full][/previewyoutube]

Star Shift 0.64 has been released! This release has fixed multiple bugs as well as added a ton of new skills that players can learn in the game. 

This video shows the basic introduction to Star Shift. The game is not currently complete, but the gameplay is pretty firm for about 30 hours. The game is meant to be much longer though. 

In Star Shift, traditional "levels" don't matter very much. But with each battle, you learn "knowledge" and you can use that to learn skills. Some Skills are active such as a certain style of attack, other skills are passive skills like "ATK goes up by 5%". 

This creates a situation in which levels don't matter, but depending on what equipment you have, or what skills you've learned, you can become extremely deadly, or really weak, even if your character's stats are the same as level 1. 

Star Shift aims to be a mix of JRPG (Japanese RPG's), WRPG (Western RPG's), and TRPG (Tactical RPG).

notes.title: Star Shift Updated to 0.52!
notes.notes:
Star Shift has been updated to version 0.52. This update adds the feature of a CYBERNET combat arena. This is basically a combat simulator you can use to gain experience and credits without being a part of the main story. 

[previewyoutube=S60PG_fr1Bc;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

We also removed the dynamic lighting plugin because we noticed that people who did not have AMD or Nvidia graphics cards were experiencing a lot of lag. 

We did however try to emulate the atmospheric vibe of the lighting effect through various tinting and fog techniques. They will improve over time. This should work well though even on Intel GPU/Integrated graphics.

Skills and animations have been improved. Projectiles such as plasma, bullets, lasers, and railguns have been improved. 

Change Log:
-Added CYBERNET Combat Arena
-Enhanced system for equipping and training armies
-Combat Balancing changes
-Tactical Battle improvements
-Storyline additions
-Added more skills for all classes
-Improved enemy AI
-Graphics upgrades
-Projectile animations improved (plasma, bullets, railgun, laser)
-Base resolution upgraded to 1280x720
-Improved Parallax backgrounds
-Number of party members in battle upgraded to 7 members instead of 6. 
-Removed dynamic lighting plugin

notes.title: Star Shift 0.39 Update
notes.notes:
Thank you to everybody who has alpha tested our game so far. A number of small bugs have been brought to our attention and they are now patched with this update. 


1. First level being too hard.
2. Items not disappearing when used in battle.
3. Addition of item drops for enemies.
4. Walking through walls on certain maps.

As a workaround for now, if you experience combat balancing difficulties, there's a difficulty slider in the options menu. 

Version 0.4 will be coming out in a few weeks and will have many more improvements added. The 0.39 build fixes the biggest 0.38 bugs.

Thank You,
Psychronic Game Studios
